# Synthetic WorkBC responses

Made-up employers, titles and links in the same shape as real WorkBC search responses
(docs/phase1-plan.md §1). Real responses are not stored here: the repo is public and WorkBC
data is never republished. Real probe responses stay on the box under `/srv/scout/logs/`.

- `page_mixed.json`: one page with an external posting (link to an ATS), a Job Bank posting
  (no link, virtual) and a posting whose city is only "British Columbia".
